mechanism: Actual TerminologyNormalizer fuzzy matcher in CPU-only laboratory. Per-term auto threshold varied; no changes in original config.
selection_data: Constructed spelling/split variants plus distinct concept and context negatives derived from frozen guards; these are NOT pronunciations.
checking_data: Existing raw ASR from the three cached baseline models, aligned to unchanged provisional references; previously explored corpus, not an independent unseen test.
prosody: Existing natural recordings only. Different models on the same recording are not different intonations. No synthetic pronunciation or new independent speaker is claimed.
protection: No updates to original glossary, package, prior research/evidence, application, provider, service or model weights.
threshold_choice: For each term choose maximum constructed-positive recovery among thresholds with zero constructed hard-negative triggers; tie-break toward higher threshold. If none is safe, disable automatic fuzzy for that term. Expose training and checking separately.
comparison: Uniform .90 vs individualized grid vs exact-only; candidate text changes are simulated in new research artifacts only. Clinical critical-cue differences reviewed separately from lexical WER.
threshold_boundary_rule: At auto=.86, suggest=.85 to satisfy strict loader ordering; at all other grid points suggest=.86. Baseline remains exactly .90/.86.
scope: Ten randomly sampled glossary concepts in recorded English references, including organization names. No rerolling after inspecting selection.
